slides.text:
It didn't give me a score

It gave me a *sentence*

Scores end conversations

74. Okay. Now what

Under today's session
there's a why

Tap it

The reason was right there

Written like a person
would say it

You don't have to
trust it blindly

That's the point

slides.heading: Ask it why
slides.body: Every SOMA recommendation opens into the reasons behind it — your sleep, your training, your recovery, written out
